name: Takai Kanae
source:
Hobbies: Saving money
Skills: Cooking
Likes: Sales
Dislikes: Living plainly, convenience store food
Favorite food: Sanma (pacific saury)
Hated food: Bread crumbs

[url=/c17268]Shotarou's[/url] classmate for a second consecutive year, Kanae is a friendly girl with excellent grades, but also very poor. Despite this, she never gives up easily, and works at a maid cafe to help her family financially. Kanae became friends with Shotarou after the infamous "sanma receipt incident".
